text:
I’ve had root canal and wisdom tooth removal here in the last 6 months. Been very happy with the service and the price seems very reasonable, if not around normal market price in Bangkok.

My 9 year old also having fillings as we speak and they have been great with her also.

Dentists all have a reasonable command of English.

I would recommend this place.
